audit_type: author-informed source semantics; no proposal, execution, or raster acceptance

semantic_requirements.requirement: Pre-training compares N image-text pairs across an N by N affinity matrix; diagonal entries are real paired examples and off-diagonals are mismatches.
Paper training uses the average of image-to-text and text-to-image cross entropy over scaled pairwise cosine scores.
Pinned forward code L2-normalizes features and returns scaled image-to-text logits plus transpose; it does not compute loss.
At test time the learned text encoder embeds target class names or descriptions to synthesize a zero-shot linear classifier; downstream use reuses image-text pairing capability.
README exposes separate image/text encoders and an example that normalizes feature vectors and ranks candidate class text by scaled dot-product similarity.
README says cosine similarities times 100; model code uses learned exp(logit_scale), so fixed times-100 is not an implementation invariant.

hard_rejections: isolated paired cards with no all-pairs N by N comparison
unnormalized dot product labeled cosine similarity
fixed times-100 scale claimed as code invariant
cross entropy claimed as output of the released forward function
target-label fitting or newly trained classifier weights in zero-shot use
training or inference execution, measured score, probability, speed, data volume, or model-size claim
copy of paper Figure 1 or Figure 3 layout, caption, or assets
pending_plan_gate: symmetric contrastive pre-training is visually distinct from zero-shot use
all-pairs N by N matrix and diagonal positives are legible
normalized embeddings and scaled cosine logits are correct
paper loss and released forward logits are not conflated
class-text reuse does not imply target-dataset fitting or actual execution
composition is original and contribution-led rather than equal-card flow
raster_stage_boundary: Require a saved pixel-only first reading before source/brief comparison. Raster review cannot accept native artifacts.
